title: Spin-polarized analysis of electronic, magnetic, photo-catalytic and thermoelectric characteristics of stable spinels BeGd 2 (S/Se) 4  for energy conversion applications
content: The application of spinel chalcogenides in thermoelectricity and optoelectronics has generated great academic interest in recent times. In this work, DFT-based WIEN2k code is used to study the mechanical, electronic, ferro-magnetic, optical, and thermoelectric properties of BeGd2(S/Se)4 spinels. Using GGA-PBEsol approximation, crystal structures and thermodynamically stable ground states of the compounds are found using energy-volume optimization and formation enthalpy (ΔHf). In addition, phonon dispersion plot having no imaginary frequency and stable AIMD simulation with constant mean value indicate both spinels are dynamically and thermally stable in the cubic phase. The mechanical properties, which include Poisson's ratio & Pugh's criterion, show that the studied compounds have a ductile nature. According to the calculated electronic band structure, using the TB-mBJ method, it is revealed that both the compounds are direct bandgap semiconductors, where BeGd2S4 has a bandgap of 1.67 eV while that of BeGd2Se4 is 1.22 eV. Optical and transport analyses of the compounds show that these compounds have good performance potential in optoelectronics and thermoelectrics applications. On a wider scale, the bandgaps indicate suitability of the compounds in photovoltaic applications.
